hooks.command: R=/mnt/project-files; if [ -f "$R/tools/hooks/dispatch.py" ]; then python3 "$R/tools/hooks/dispatch.py" pre-merge || exit 2; else echo 'Publish gate: this session cannot reach the Project Files folder, so the merge is refused.
